title: ProductPortability
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Portability viability dimension. Defines the property vocabulary for portability governance: containerization, cloud-provider agnosticism, configuration externalization, and vendor lock-in assessment. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying portability posture state. Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture — migration planning, platform independence) + ISO/IEC 25010 (Portability — Adaptability, Installability, Replaceability). Coherence note: fills a gap identified in the TOGAF coherence audit — ISO 25010 Portability is a core quality characteristic relevant to cloud migration governance.

containerized.description: Whether the component is containerized (OCI-compliant image). Norm example: Portability.containerized == true.

cloudProviderAgnostic.description: Whether the component avoids cloud-provider-specific APIs/services. Drives vendor lock-in analysis.

configExternalized.description: Whether configuration is externalized from the deployment artifact (12-factor app principle).

dataExportFormat.description: Primary data export format for migration/portability scenarios. NONE = no bulk export capability.

vendorLockInLevel.description: Assessed vendor lock-in level. NONE = fully portable. LOW = minor adaptation needed. MEDIUM = significant migration effort. HIGH = deeply coupled to vendor platform.
